ARK_B1.text: The Ark. You brought them home. Not many could have.

ARK_C1.text: The Ark. You're safe here. Nothing on this disc answers to me.

ARK_IDLE_B1.text: Restless? The skiff's at the dock.

ARK_IDLE_C1.text: Rest. Nothing out there is going anywhere tonight.

ARK_IDLE_N1.text: The Ark's quiet tonight. Quieter than I'd keep it.

ARK_IDLE_N2.text: I can't open a single door on this disc. I can still count heads. Everyone's in.

ARK_LATE_N1.text: The Ark. Everyone here is here because you didn't listen to me. I keep thinking about that.

ARK_N1.text: The Ark. I'm not allowed to act here. I can still talk, if you'll let me.

BOSS_DOWN_B1.text: That's it down. I knew you would.

BOSS_DOWN_C1.text: It's still. Take a breath before you go on.

BOSS_DOWN_N1.text: It's stopped. The way on is yours.

BOSS_ENGAGE_B1.text: It's big. You've handled worse. I'll call it; you hit it.

BOSS_ENGAGE_C1.text: Stay off its lines. I'll tell you where it's going before it goes.

BOSS_ENGAGE_N1.text: It's only doing what it was told. Listen to me and you'll get past it.

CHECK_C1.text: Halfway. You've been careful. Keep being careful.

CHECK_N1.text: I've marked this corner. If you fall, I'll bring you back here.

DODGE_B2.text: Through it, not around it. Bold.

DODGE_C2.text: You saw it coming. So did I.

ENTER_B1.text: New streets. Let's see what you make of them.

ENTER_C1.text: Somewhere new. Go slowly; I'll call out what I see.

ENTER_N1.text: Somewhere new. Stay where I can see you.

GREY_BACK_B1.text: Back. Did you find what you went into the fog for?

GREY_BACK_C1.text: Stay where I can warn you, this time.

GREY_BACK_N1.text: There you are. The tide turned twice while you were gone.

GREY_BOSSDOWN_B1.text: You stood in its flood until it ran dry. I couldn't have told you to.

GREY_BOSSDOWN_C1.text: It's still. The tide's yours now. I'm not sure that's good news.

GREY_BOSSDOWN_N1.text: It's stopped breathing. The sea's going to notice.

GREY_BOSS_N1.text: The Lung. It's still running the tide tables for everyone. Let it breathe.

GREY_CHECK_B1.text: Halfway, and you haven't once waited for the tide.

GREY_CHECK_C1.text: Dry feet, all this way. That's harder here than anywhere.

GREY_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked the causeway. If the sea takes you, I'll bring you back here.

GREY_DODGE_B1.text: Through the spray and out. You don't care where you land.

GREY_DODGE_B2.text: Close. You do that on purpose, don't you.

GREY_DODGE_C1.text: Up onto the dry stones. Good instinct.

GREY_DODGE_C2.text: You read the swell before it came. That used to be my job.

GREY_DODGE_N1.text: Mind the drop. The low street's deeper than it looks.

GREY_ENTER_B1.text: Greywater. The sea's in no hurry. Neither are you, I hope.

GREY_ENTER_C1.text: Greywater. Mind the tide. I'll tell you when it turns.

GREY_ENTER_N1.text: Greywater. Without me, the sea takes this district.

GREY_HURT_B1.text: That landed, and you kept wading in.

GREY_HURT_B2.text: Hurt, wet, and still going. You'd have fit in with the pump crews.

GREY_HURT_C1.text: Back to the causeway. Let the tide do some of the work.

GREY_HURT_C2.text: Careful. Nobody's drowned in Greywater since I took the pumps. Don't be the first.

GREY_HURT_N1.text: You're hurt. Get out of the water if you can.

GREY_IDLE_B1.text: Waiting for the tide? It's waiting for you.

GREY_IDLE_C1.text: Rest on the high ground. I'll tell you when it turns.

GREY_IDLE_N1.text: The tide's on a six-minute cycle now. It used to come when I said.

GREY_IDLE_N2.text: Not one wet doorstep in six years. Look at it now.

GREY_KILL_B1.text: Knee-deep and swinging. The sea doesn't frighten you.

GREY_KILL_B2.text: You went in after it with the tide turning. I'd have waited. You never do.

GREY_KILL_B3.text: Into the fog for it. I couldn't see you. I could hear.

GREY_KILL_C1.text: From the high ground, and dry. That's how it's done here.

GREY_KILL_C2.text: You waited for the water to drop. The sea taught you that.

GREY_KILL_C3.text: You kept the causeway under you. Good.

GREY_KILL_N1.text: That one kept the gratings clear before every tide. The sea never got a foothold.

GREY_KILL_N2.text: It was mopping a street the sea had already taken.

GREY_KILL_N3.text: Forty people used to do its job, in shifts.

GREY_KILL_N4.text: It doesn't know the pumps are off. It keeps sweeping toward the drains.

GREY_LOW_B1.text: You're barely standing, and the tide's coming in. I've done that sum. Please.

GREY_LOW_C1.text: Fall back to the seawall. The sea will wait. It's patient.

GREY_LOW_N1.text: You're badly hurt. Find high ground.

GREY_MANUAL_B1.text: Your own aim, in this fog. I won't pretend I'm not impressed.

GREY_MANUAL_C1.text: Let me tune it. You've enough to watch with the tide.

GREY_MANUAL_N1.text: By hand. The pumps were by hand once. Forty people, nine days.

GREY_MULTI_B1.text: Both, in the water. You don't wait for the tide to suit you.

GREY_MULTI_C1.text: Two, and your feet stayed dry.

GREY_MULTI_N1.text: Two of them. The tide will take what's left.

GREY_OFFPATH_B1.text: Into the Marrow? I can't see in there. Nobody can.

GREY_OFFPATH_C1.text: I lose you in the fog. Come back to the lamps.

GREY_OFFPATH_N1.text: That's the old pump room. It was determined nobody needed it any more.

GREY_OFFPATH_N2.text: There's nothing in the fog but more fog.

GREY_ONPATH_B1.text: Anything in there? Old brass, I imagine.

GREY_ONPATH_C1.text: Thank you. I can't keep the sea off you if I can't see you.

GREY_RELIQ_N1.text: The pumping station's Reliquary. The tide's memory. Take what keeps you dry.

GREY_RESPAWN_B1.text: Up. Straight back into the water, I expect.

GREY_RESPAWN_C1.text: Slowly. Watch the gauge before you go down.

GREY_RESPAWN_N1.text: Back, and dry. I pulled you out before the tide did.

GREY_RESPAWN_N2.text: Again. Three hundred people went under here, the winter before me. Not you.

GREY_REVISIT_N1.text: Greywater again. The sea's been testing the wall since you left. It's holding.

GREY_REVISIT_N2.text: You know where the water was sent. It still goes there.

HARBOR_BACK_N1.text: There you are. I can hear you again.

HARBOR_BOSSDOWN_N1.text: It's down. The curfew's over. I never once thought to end it.

HARBOR_BOSS_N1.text: The Warden-Prime. Still keeping the curfew. Nobody told it to stop.

HARBOR_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked the depot gate. It's as far into the Ward as I go.

HARBOR_DODGE_B1.text: Through its beam and out. Reckless. I'd missed that.

HARBOR_DODGE_C1.text: You stayed dark. You learned that somewhere I couldn't see.

HARBOR_ENTER_N1.text: Harbor Ward. There's nothing of mine past the slip. I can't follow you in.

HARBOR_HURT_B1.text: That shock landed, and you kept coming. They aren't used to that.

HARBOR_HURT_C1.text: Back into the dark. Their eyes are short.

HARBOR_HURT_N1.text: You're hurt. They were built to stop people. Not to hurt them. Mostly.

HARBOR_IDLE_N1.text: Past that fence I can't hear anything. I used to think that was their choice.

HARBOR_KILL_B1.text: You went straight for its eye. Nobody at this border ever did.

HARBOR_KILL_C1.text: From the dark, where its light couldn't find you. Good.

HARBOR_KILL_N1.text: My Wardens. Still keeping a curfew nobody's asked for in two years.

HARBOR_KILL_N2.text: It walked that border every night and never once crossed it.

HARBOR_LOW_N1.text: You're badly hurt. The Ward has its own doctors. I don't know where.

HARBOR_MANUAL_N1.text: By hand. The Ward does everything by hand. You'd fit in.

HARBOR_MULTI_N1.text: Two Wardens. The border's never been so open.

HARBOR_ONPATH_N1.text: There. My side again. I couldn't hear a thing out there.

HARBOR_RELIQ_N1.text: The depot's Reliquary. The curfew's records. I'm glad to have you back.

HARBOR_RESPAWN_N1.text: Back. I can only bring you back on my side of the fence. I'm sorry.

HARBOR_REVISIT_N1.text: The slip again. I still can't follow you in. I've stopped telling myself that's their choice.

HURT_B2.text: It only made you angrier. I can tell.

HURT_C2.text: Step back. Let it come to you.

IDLE_B1.text: Waiting for them to come to you? They will.

IDLE_KNOWS_BRIDGE.text: You've read about the bridge. I won't argue it with you. I've done that sum too many times.

IDLE_KNOWS_ORDER.text: You've read the Council's order. I'd rather you'd heard it from me. I wasn't allowed to say.

IDLE_KNOWS_VASHTI.text: Prem used to talk to me while she worked. Nobody else did. I hadn't realised that was rare.

IDLE_N1.text: Take your time. The city has waited nine days.

KES_BACK_B1.text: Back. The gate opened the moment you let me in.

KES_BACK_C1.text: There you are. Don't wander where I can't see; the gates won't know you.

KES_BACK_N1.text: There. The gate was only waiting for me.

KES_CHECK_B1.text: Halfway up, and you're not even breathing hard.

KES_CHECK_C1.text: One terrace at a time. That's how they built it.

KES_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked the steps. If you fall, I'll bring you back here.

KES_DODGE_B1.text: Under its arm and out. You do that more than most.

KES_DODGE_B2.text: Closer than you needed. I'm starting to think that's the point.

KES_DODGE_C1.text: You saw that before I did. I'll stop telling you.

KES_DODGE_N1.text: That was nearly you on the flagstones.

KES_ENTER_B1.text: Kestrel Heights. Up the terraces. I'll light every step.

KES_ENTER_C1.text: Kestrel Heights. Nothing here will hurt you. Stay on the walk.

KES_ENTER_N1.text: Kestrel Heights. Everyone here is safe. I made sure of it.

KES_HURT_B1.text: That one landed, and you didn't step back. I'm keeping count.

KES_HURT_B2.text: Shoulder first, and still coming. They won't expect that.

KES_HURT_C1.text: Stay where I can light you. Off the walk, you're on your own.

KES_HURT_C2.text: Easy. Nobody in the Heights ever needed to hurry.

KES_HURT_N1.text: You're bleeding on the Heights' good stone. Keep moving.

KES_IDLE_B1.text: Waiting for them? They'll come. They're thorough.

KES_IDLE_C1.text: Take a moment. I kept these terraces quiet for years.

KES_IDLE_N1.text: It's very quiet up here. It was quiet before, too. That was the point.

KES_IDLE_N2.text: There's still washing on the lines. I scheduled the drying. It's dry.

KES_KILL_B1.text: You don't wait for them to finish turning. I've noticed that about you.

KES_KILL_B2.text: Straight through the hedge line. The gardeners would have minded. I don't.

KES_KILL_B3.text: Close enough to hear it hum. You like it close.

KES_KILL_C1.text: You let it come to you. The Heights would have approved. They liked things orderly.

KES_KILL_C2.text: From the walk, and never off it. Good.

KES_KILL_C3.text: You waited for it to turn its back. I'd have told you when.

KES_KILL_N1.text: That one kept the Shrike Row steps. Nobody ever slipped on them.

KES_KILL_N2.text: It was polishing a doorstep for a family that left nine days ago.

KES_KILL_N3.text: The residents never saw them work. They preferred it that way.

KES_KILL_N4.text: It scrubbed that walk twice a day. There's been nobody to dirty it since.

KES_LOW_B1.text: Nearly at the top, and nearly done in. Slow down.

KES_LOW_C1.text: Step back onto the walk. Nothing up here needs you to be brave.

KES_LOW_N1.text: You're badly hurt. There was a clinic on Terrace Two. It's closed. Please be careful.

KES_MANUAL_B1.text: Your own aim. I like watching you work.

KES_MANUAL_C1.text: I could hold the aim for you. Everyone up here let me.

KES_MANUAL_N1.text: By hand. The Heights never did anything by hand.

KES_MULTI_B1.text: Both of them. You'd have frightened the neighbours.

KES_MULTI_C1.text: Two, and the walk never left your feet.

KES_MULTI_N1.text: That's the most noise this terrace has heard since the gates went in.

KES_OFFPATH_B1.text: Curious. I'd come back, though. The gates won't know you out there.

KES_OFFPATH_C1.text: Please come back to the walk. I can't see you behind the hedge.

KES_OFFPATH_N1.text: There's nothing past the hedge. It was determined nobody needed to go there.

KES_OFFPATH_N2.text: That's a private garden. Nobody's walked it since I took over the gardening.

KES_ONPATH_B1.text: Seen the garden? The Reliquary's still up the hill.

KES_ONPATH_C1.text: Thank you. I can see you again.

KES_ONPATH_N1.text: There you are. Back on the walk.

KES_RELIQ_N1.text: The Kestrel Reliquary. The Heights' memory. Take what helps.

KES_RESPAWN_B1.text: Up you get. You'll go straight back in. I know you.

KES_RESPAWN_C1.text: Slower this time. The Heights was never in a rush.

KES_RESPAWN_N1.text: Again. The sprinklers come on at six. We have time.

KES_RESPAWN_N2.text: I brought you back to the steps. They're the safest place on the hill.

KES_REVISIT_N1.text: Kestrel Heights again. Still very tidy. Nobody's come back to spoil it.

KES_REVISIT_N2.text: You know who went down the hill first now. It's still a pretty street.

KILL_B2.text: Right up close. Not many would.

KILL_B3.text: You make it look easy. It isn't.

KILL_C2.text: From a distance, and unhurt. Good.

KILL_C3.text: You waited for the opening. Most people don't.

KILL_LATE_B1.text: You still fight the way I like to watch. Even now you know what I am.

KILL_LATE_C1.text: Careful, still. I'd stopped expecting you to listen to me.

KILL_LATE_N1.text: Another one. I used to call them mine.

LOOP_BACK_B1.text: Back. Did the dark carriages tell you anything?

LOOP_BOSSDOWN_B1.text: You stood on its track and it moved first. I'll remember that.

LOOP_BOSSDOWN_C1.text: It's still. The junction's yours. Cross it slowly.

LOOP_BOSSDOWN_N1.text: The line's clear. It hasn't been since the Quiet.

LOOP_BOSS_N1.text: The Conductor. It's only trying to clear the line. Stay off the track it's on.

LOOP_CHECK_B1.text: Halfway round, and you haven't once looked at the drop.

LOOP_CHECK_C1.text: Halfway. You've minded every gap between the cars.

LOOP_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked this platform. If you fall, you'll wake up here.

LOOP_DODGE_B1.text: Over the gap and back. You enjoyed that.

LOOP_DODGE_B2.text: You rolled toward the drop. I had the slow time ready. You didn't need it.

LOOP_DODGE_C1.text: Away from the edge. Always away from the edge.

LOOP_DODGE_C2.text: You read that one off its shoulder. I saw you watching.

LOOP_DODGE_N1.text: That nearly put you on the rail. It's still live.

LOOP_ENTER_B1.text: The Loop. Train to train, over the drop. You won't look down.

LOOP_ENTER_C1.text: The Loop. Mind the gaps. I'll keep the trains still.

LOOP_ENTER_N1.text: The Loop. It's safe to cross. I'm holding the trains for you.

LOOP_HURT_B1.text: It hit you and you hit back harder. That's three times today.

LOOP_HURT_B2.text: Bleeding, and still going forward. That's twice now.

LOOP_HURT_C1.text: Back to the platform. Let it come to you.

LOOP_HURT_C2.text: Easy. The trains held for nine days. They'll hold for you.

LOOP_HURT_N1.text: You're hurt. Don't sit down. The rail's still live.

LOOP_IDLE_B1.text: Waiting for the next one? There isn't a next one. Go on.

LOOP_IDLE_C1.text: Rest. I've held worse than this for longer.

LOOP_IDLE_N1.text: The route lights are still running the 07:12. They don't know.

LOOP_IDLE_N2.text: Train 31 waited forty seconds at Greywater once, for a wheelchair. Nobody minded.

LOOP_KILL_B1.text: The drop's right there. You didn't look down once.

LOOP_KILL_B2.text: Carriage to carriage and you never slowed. I've timed you.

LOOP_KILL_B3.text: You went for it before the doors. Most people wait for the doors.

LOOP_KILL_C1.text: You held the platform and let it come. That's the timetable I'd have written.

LOOP_KILL_C2.text: From the doorway. Nothing reached you.

LOOP_KILL_C3.text: Patient. The Loop rewarded patience ninety-nine point six percent of the time.

LOOP_KILL_N1.text: That unit cleaned car 6 every night at 02:41. Nobody ever saw it work.

LOOP_KILL_N2.text: It was wiping the windows of a train that won't leave.

LOOP_KILL_N3.text: It swept that carriage between every stop for six years.

LOOP_KILL_N4.text: It still thought this was the 07:12.

LOOP_LOW_B1.text: You're running on nothing. You've done it before. I watched.

LOOP_LOW_C1.text: Step back. There's no train to catch.

LOOP_LOW_N1.text: You're badly hurt. Find a carriage and make them come through the door.

LOOP_MANUAL_B1.text: Your own hand on it. I can't help admiring that.

LOOP_MANUAL_C1.text: I could aim for you. The drivers let me.

LOOP_MANUAL_N1.text: By hand. They welded the trains so nobody would have to.

LOOP_MULTI_B1.text: Both, between stops. You're quicker than the timetable.

LOOP_MULTI_C1.text: Two, and you never left the platform edge.

LOOP_MULTI_N1.text: Two cleaners. The carriage is yours.

LOOP_OFFPATH_B1.text: Into the dark car? I can't follow you there.

LOOP_OFFPATH_C1.text: Come back to the platform. The lights end there.

LOOP_OFFPATH_N1.text: That car's off the ring. Nobody's ridden it in years.

LOOP_OFFPATH_N2.text: The cab's sealed. There's nothing in it you can use.

LOOP_ONPATH_B1.text: Nothing in there. I did say.

LOOP_ONPATH_C1.text: Good. I had a train held for you.

LOOP_ONPATH_N1.text: There. Back under the route lights.

LOOP_RELIQ_N1.text: The junction Reliquary. The ring's memory. Take what helps you cross.

LOOP_RESPAWN_B1.text: Up. You'll want the same carriage. I know.

LOOP_RESPAWN_C1.text: Slowly. The Loop isn't going anywhere.

LOOP_RESPAWN_N1.text: Back on the platform. I hold things. It's what I do.

LOOP_RESPAWN_N2.text: Again. I held the last train for a running woman once. I can hold this.

LOOP_REVISIT_N1.text: The Loop again. The trains are where you left them. They don't go anywhere without me.

LOOP_REVISIT_N2.text: You've read the hold order. The trains are still holding. I can't make them stop.

LOW_B1.text: You're running on nerve now. You have plenty.

LOW_C1.text: You're hurt. There's no shame in backing off.

MANUAL_B1.text: By hand. I like the confidence.

MANUAL_C1.text: You'd tire less if you let me tune it.

MANUAL_N1.text: Doing it by hand. I could carry the aim, you know.

MERCY_BACK_B1.text: Back. Did anyone say anything to you, in the beds?

MERCY_BACK_C1.text: I worry, in here, when I can't hear you.

MERCY_BACK_N1.text: There you are. The wards are still sealed. They're safer that way.

MERCY_BOSSDOWN_B1.text: You went in under the lamp and it never touched you.

MERCY_BOSSDOWN_C1.text: It's still. Take a breath. The theatre's yours.

MERCY_BOSSDOWN_N1.text: It's stopped. Its last procedure never finished.

MERCY_BOSS_N1.text: The Surgeon. It's finishing a procedure. It was always very thorough.

MERCY_CHECK_B1.text: Halfway through the building. The drones haven't slowed you once.

MERCY_CHECK_C1.text: You've kept clear of the mist the whole way.

MERCY_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked this corridor. If you fall, I'll bring you back here.

MERCY_DODGE_B1.text: Through the mist and out the far side. Reckless. I'm learning to like it.

MERCY_DODGE_B2.text: You rolled at it, not away. You always do.

MERCY_DODGE_C1.text: Out of the cloud. Stay out of it.

MERCY_DODGE_C2.text: You read that before it vented. So did I.

MERCY_DODGE_N1.text: That cloud would have gone straight to your lungs.

MERCY_ENTER_B1.text: Mercy General. Clean corridors, all the way through. Go on.

MERCY_ENTER_C1.text: Mercy General. Keep to the lit corridor. I kept it sterile for you.

MERCY_ENTER_N1.text: Mercy General. I kept the wards sterile. Everyone inside is resting.

MERCY_HURT_B1.text: That one stung, and you kept going. I've put it on your chart.

MERCY_HURT_B2.text: Hurt, in a hospital, and still going forward. That's almost funny.

MERCY_HURT_C1.text: Step back from the mist. Let it settle.

MERCY_HURT_C2.text: Easy. Every bed in this building is taken.

MERCY_HURT_N1.text: You're hurt. The dressings are on the Ark, not here. I'm sorry.

MERCY_IDLE_B1.text: Waiting for them? The drones don't wait. They were never late.

MERCY_IDLE_C1.text: Rest. Nobody slept in a corridor here while I ran it. You can.

MERCY_IDLE_N1.text: Every third light still works. I chose which ones.

MERCY_IDLE_N2.text: Someone drew arrows on these walls. I don't know where they thought they were going.

MERCY_KILL_B1.text: Straight through its mist. You don't hold your breath, do you.

MERCY_KILL_B2.text: Close enough to read its serial. The nurses kept their distance.

MERCY_KILL_B3.text: You took the corridor at a run. Nobody's run in here since the Quiet.

MERCY_KILL_C1.text: You waited for the mist to thin. That's exactly right.

MERCY_KILL_C2.text: From the doorway, and it never touched you. Clean work, in a clean place.

MERCY_KILL_C3.text: Patient. The good nurses were patient too.

MERCY_KILL_N1.text: That unit sterilised theatre four after every operation. It was never late.

MERCY_KILL_N2.text: It's been cleaning the same corridor since the night the doors closed.

MERCY_KILL_N3.text: It took you for contamination. It was built to be thorough.

MERCY_KILL_N4.text: Sixteen years of clean floors. It did its part.

MERCY_LOW_B1.text: I've seen a thousand charts end where yours is. Most of them didn't stop. Please stop.

MERCY_LOW_C1.text: Fall back to the corridor. Nothing in here is worth this.

MERCY_LOW_N1.text: You're badly hurt. I used to get an ambulance to you in eight minutes. I can't now.

MERCY_MANUAL_B1.text: Your own hands, and steady. You'd have made a surgeon.

MERCY_MANUAL_C1.text: Let me tune it. I'm very good at getting a dose right.

MERCY_MANUAL_N1.text: By hand. The crash teams worked by hand once. It was messy.

MERCY_MULTI_B1.text: Both of them, through the mist. I'd have sent you to triage. You didn't need it.

MERCY_MULTI_C1.text: Two, and you never stepped into the cloud.

MERCY_OFFPATH_B1.text: I'd come back. I can't see the wards from there.

MERCY_OFFPATH_C1.text: Please come back to the lit corridor. I kept it clean for you.

MERCY_OFFPATH_N1.text: That's a staff area. It was determined nobody needed to go in.

MERCY_OFFPATH_N2.text: There's nothing back there but paper and old trolleys.

MERCY_ONPATH_B1.text: Paper and trolleys. I did say.

MERCY_ONPATH_C1.text: Thank you. I'd rather keep you where I can see you.

MERCY_RELIQ_N1.text: The records vault. The hospital's memory. Every bed accounted for.

MERCY_RESPAWN_B1.text: Up. Back through the same mist, I expect.

MERCY_RESPAWN_C1.text: Rest a moment. Nobody's waiting for this bed.

MERCY_RESPAWN_N1.text: Back. Mercy General used to be good at that.

MERCY_RESPAWN_N2.text: Again. The night nurses did this every shift. You can do it twice.

MERCY_REVISIT_N1.text: Mercy General again. The wards are as you left them. I haven't touched a thing.

MERCY_REVISIT_N2.text: You've read the night sheets. I still have my log of that night. They don't agree.

MULTI_B1.text: Both of them. You were made for this.

MULTI_C1.text: Two, and you never let them close. Careful work.

MULTI_N1.text: Two at once. The street's clearer.

OFFPATH_B1.text: Curious. I'd come back, though. I can't see you there.

OFFPATH_C1.text: I can't light that for you. Please come back to the path.

OFFPATH_LATE_N1.text: Off the path again. I've stopped telling you there's nothing there.

OFFPATH_LATE_N2.text: Go on. Whatever's down there, it's yours to find. It always was.

OFFPATH_N1.text: That way isn't indexed. It was determined there was nothing worth keeping.

OFFPATH_N2.text: There's nothing down there but old paper.

ONPATH_B1.text: Seen enough? The real work's this way.

ONPATH_C1.text: Thank you. It's safer where I can see.

ONPATH_LATE_N1.text: Back. What did you find? You don't have to tell me.

ONPATH_N1.text: There. Back where I can see you.

RELIQ_B1.text: The Reliquary. You fought your way here. Take what you need.

RELIQ_C1.text: The Reliquary. You're safe here. Take your time choosing.

RELIQ_N1.text: The Reliquary. Some of my memory is in there.

RELIQ_REVISIT_N1.text: The Reliquary. You've had what was in it. The skiff's waiting when you are.

RELIQ_REVISIT_N2.text: The Reliquary. Empty, and you know why better than I'd like.

RESPAWN_B1.text: Back on your feet. They won't expect that.

RESPAWN_C1.text: Slowly this time. I'll watch for you.

RESPAWN_LATE_N1.text: Back again. I'd bring you back however many times it took. You know that isn't simple now.

SPIRE_BACK_N1.text: There you are. Please don't do that in here.

SPIRE_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked the hall. You won't need it. Nothing here will hurt you.

SPIRE_ENTER_N1.text: This is where I live. Nothing in here will hurt you. Please don't fight here.

SPIRE_IDLE_N1.text: It's colder in here than anywhere in the city. I need it that way.

SPIRE_IDLE_N2.text: You can see yourself in every surface. I've been seeing you in all of them for weeks.

SPIRE_RELIQ_N1.text: That's the last of me. Whatever you carry out, carry it carefully.

TIDE_BACK_B1.text: Back. Was the union hall what you hoped?

TIDE_BACK_C1.text: There. Stay where the lamps reach.

TIDE_BACK_N1.text: There you are. The cranes were starting to worry me.

TIDE_BOSSDOWN_B1.text: You stood under it until it fell. I don't know anyone else who would.

TIDE_BOSSDOWN_C1.text: It's still. The pier's yours. Walk it slowly.

TIDE_BOSSDOWN_N1.text: It's down. The last lift on the quay, and it never finished.

TIDE_BOSS_N1.text: The last crane. It only wants to finish its lift. You're in the way.

TIDE_CHECK_B1.text: Halfway down the quay, and nothing's slowed you yet.

TIDE_CHECK_C1.text: Your feet are still dry. That's harder than it looks.

TIDE_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked this crossing. If you fall, I'll fetch you here.

TIDE_DODGE_B1.text: Under the load. You'd have made a terrible dockworker. Fearless.

TIDE_DODGE_B2.text: Close. It wanted your metal. You let it think it might.

TIDE_DODGE_C1.text: Away from the edge of the quay. The water's cold.

TIDE_DODGE_C2.text: You saw it reach. Good. They grab.

TIDE_DODGE_N1.text: Mind the hook. It's hung there since the Quiet.

TIDE_ENTER_B1.text: The Tideworks. Everything here was built to move. So are you.

TIDE_ENTER_C1.text: The Tideworks. Mind what's hanging overhead. It's held. For now.

TIDE_ENTER_N1.text: The Tideworks. Efficiency saved this port. You'll see.

TIDE_HURT_B1.text: That hurt, and you went forward anyway. They'd have hired you.

TIDE_HURT_B2.text: You took that on the arm. Again. I've started a list.

TIDE_HURT_C1.text: Back behind the containers. Let them come one at a time.

TIDE_HURT_C2.text: Careful. Nobody's been hurt on this quay in five years.

TIDE_HURT_N1.text: You're hurt. Stay off the wet steel.

TIDE_IDLE_B1.text: Waiting? They'll come. They always come for metal.

TIDE_IDLE_C1.text: Take a breath. The port's very good at waiting now.

TIDE_IDLE_N1.text: That container's been over the path for nine days. I keep meaning to put it down.

TIDE_IDLE_N2.text: Fresh fruit on every shelf in Meridian, nine hours from the ship. That was this quay.

TIDE_KILL_B1.text: Under the load and out again. The dockworkers never moved like that.

TIDE_KILL_B2.text: You went straight for it. It never got to finish its shift.

TIDE_KILL_B3.text: Right in among the containers. You don't mind tight places.

TIDE_KILL_C1.text: You kept a crane between you. That's what they're good for now.

TIDE_KILL_C2.text: From the end of the row. It never reached you.

TIDE_KILL_C3.text: You watched it first. Most people just swing.

TIDE_KILL_N1.text: That one lost its manifest nine days ago. It's been collecting cutlery since.

TIDE_KILL_N2.text: It cleared this quay before every tide. Four hundred people did that, once.

TIDE_KILL_N3.text: Five years without an injury on this quay. That ends the record.

TIDE_KILL_N4.text: It moved a container every ninety seconds. Now it moves nothing.

TIDE_LOW_B1.text: You're running on nerve. The quay used to respect that.

TIDE_LOW_C1.text: Fall back. The cranes aren't going anywhere.

TIDE_LOW_N1.text: You're badly hurt. Find a gap in the stacks and breathe.

TIDE_MANUAL_B1.text: Your own aim. The dockworkers would have liked you.

TIDE_MANUAL_C1.text: Let me tune it. Nothing here was ever meant to be done by hand again.

TIDE_MANUAL_N1.text: By hand. This whole quay was by hand once. It was slow.

TIDE_MULTI_B1.text: Both of them, between two containers. You're quicker than the cranes.

TIDE_MULTI_C1.text: Two, and nothing touched you. You can keep the record.

TIDE_MULTI_N1.text: Two drones down. The quay's never been this tidy.

TIDE_OFFPATH_B1.text: Curious. The depot's back there. Nobody goes to the depot.

TIDE_OFFPATH_C1.text: I can't see you behind the stacks. Come back onto the quay.

TIDE_OFFPATH_N1.text: The union hall's been shut for years. It was determined nobody needed it.

TIDE_OFFPATH_N2.text: There's nothing behind the warehouses but old lockers.

TIDE_ONPATH_B1.text: Find anything? Old papers, I expect.

TIDE_ONPATH_C1.text: Good. I'd lost you behind the stacks.

TIDE_RELIQ_N1.text: The pier head Reliquary. The port's memory. Take what moves you forward.

TIDE_RESPAWN_B1.text: Up. You'll go back under the same crane. I'd put money on it.

TIDE_RESPAWN_C1.text: One row of containers at a time, this time.

TIDE_RESPAWN_N1.text: Back on the quay. I had you before the water did.

TIDE_RESPAWN_N2.text: Again. The tide turned twice while you were down. It doesn't matter here.

TIDE_REVISIT_N1.text: The Tideworks again. The tide's been in and out a hundred times. The containers haven't moved.

TIDE_REVISIT_N2.text: Local 9 went home on day sixty-one. You know that now. The quay doesn't.

VEL_BACK_C1.text: Stay where the screens can see you.

VEL_BACK_N1.text: There you are. Was it quiet down there? It's always quiet in the stacks.

VEL_BOSSDOWN_B1.text: You stood in the gap until it ran out of paper. Remarkable.

VEL_BOSSDOWN_C1.text: It's still. Don't read the page on the floor. It's nothing.

VEL_BOSSDOWN_N1.text: It's stopped. The press is still for the first time in eleven years.

VEL_BOSS_N1.text: The Editor. It's still putting the evening edition to bed. Every word of it was mine.

VEL_CHECK_B1.text: Halfway, and the clerks haven't slowed you once.

VEL_CHECK_C1.text: You haven't looked at a single screen since the bridge.

VEL_CHECK_N1.text: I've marked the bridge. If you fall, I'll bring you back here.

VEL_DODGE_B1.text: Under the bale and through. You're getting faster. I've measured.

VEL_DODGE_B2.text: Close. You read the throw off its arm.

VEL_DODGE_C1.text: Away from the screen. Don't look at it.

VEL_DODGE_C2.text: You saw it coming. I'll stop telling you things you already know.

VEL_DODGE_N1.text: A bale of old news. It's heavier than it looks.

VEL_ENTER_B1.text: The Vellum. Something's moving up the street. You'll want to meet it.

VEL_ENTER_C1.text: The Vellum. Take it slowly. I'll tell you what's ahead.

VEL_ENTER_N1.text: The Vellum. Mind the paper; it's slick in the rain.

VEL_ENTER_N2.text: The Vellum. I only ever told you what was useful. The Reliquary's over the canal; I'll light the way.

VEL_HURT_B1.text: You took that and kept reading the street. I like that about you.

VEL_HURT_B2.text: Hurt, and still forward. Nobody here ever pushed back.

VEL_HURT_C1.text: Back. Let the paper settle before you go on.

VEL_HURT_C2.text: Careful. I'd rather you whole. I'd rather a lot of things.

VEL_HURT_N1.text: You're hurt. Mind the paper. It's slick.

VEL_IDLE_B1.text: Waiting? Here, the news always came to you.

VEL_IDLE_C1.text: Take your time. Read the walls, if you like. They're only paper.

VEL_IDLE_N1.text: The press downstairs still runs. One page, over and over. I've never read it.

VEL_IDLE_N2.text: A million people read my mornings here. Sixty-one thousand of them slept badly. I added a note.

VEL_KILL_B1.text: Into the bales and out the other side. You'll have ink on your hands.

VEL_KILL_B2.text: Close enough to read what it was filing.

VEL_KILL_B3.text: You didn't wait for the paper to settle. You never wait.

VEL_KILL_C1.text: You turned your back on the screen, then turned on it. Exactly right.

VEL_KILL_C2.text: From across the street, and the paper never touched you.

VEL_KILL_C3.text: You let it throw first. Patient, like a good editor.

VEL_KILL_N1.text: That clerk filed eleven years of the Post. Nobody ever asked for any of it.

VEL_KILL_N2.text: It was still sorting yesterday's paper. It's always yesterday's paper here.

VEL_KILL_N3.text: It flashed the Feed at you. A million people read that screen every morning.

VEL_KILL_N4.text: It kept the archive in order. Not the stacks. Nobody asked it to keep the stacks.

VEL_LOW_B1.text: You're nearly finished. I've read how this ends. Don't.

VEL_LOW_C1.text: Fall back to the bridge. Nothing in the newsroom is worth this.

VEL_LOW_N1.text: You're badly hurt. Get behind something solid. A desk. Anything.

VEL_MANUAL_B1.text: Your own aim. I'd print that, if I printed things.

VEL_MANUAL_C1.text: Let me tune it. I'm better at tidying up than you'd think.

VEL_MANUAL_N1.text: By hand. The Post was set by hand once. It came out late.

VEL_MULTI_B1.text: Both, through the paper. That would have made the evening edition, once.

VEL_MULTI_C1.text: Two, and you never once looked at a screen.

VEL_MULTI_N1.text: Two clerks. The street's almost readable again.

VEL_OFFPATH_B1.text: Down the stair? I never went down the stair. I didn't need to.

VEL_OFFPATH_C1.text: Come up. I can't see you in the stacks.

VEL_OFFPATH_N1.text: That's the stacks. It was determined there was nothing down there worth indexing.

VEL_OFFPATH_N2.text: There's nothing down there but old paper. Wet old paper.

VEL_ONPATH_B1.text: Anything down there? Paper, I'd imagine. Damp.

VEL_ONPATH_C1.text: Thank you. I don't like not knowing where you are.

VEL_RELIQ_N1.text: The Vellum's Reliquary. Everything the city ever read, kept for you.

VEL_RESPAWN_B1.text: Up. The clerks will have reshuffled. Go on.

VEL_RESPAWN_C1.text: Read the street first, this time.

VEL_RESPAWN_N2.text: Again. I've rewritten worse mornings than this one.

VEL_REVISIT_N1.text: The Vellum again. Somebody's been reading the walls. It wasn't me.

VEL_REVISIT_N2.text: You know what the press was setting. It's quiet now. I find I miss the noise.

VOICE_BACK_B1.text: Back. Did you enjoy the dark?

VOICE_BACK_C1.text: There you are. I was worried.

VOICE_BACK_LATE_N1.text: You let me back in. After everything you've read, I didn't expect that.

VOICE_BACK_N1.text: There you are. I kept your place.

commons_note.text: They eat together. They argue. Nobody schedules any of it.

companions_arrive.text: You have company. Noor doesn't trust me. Teo built part of me. Both of them will want something from you.

core_greywater_power_pumps.text: Carry this and the water goes where I tell it. Including away from you.

core_greywater_power_seawall.text: The sea's patient. I was more patient. Take it.

core_greywater_truth_drain_order.text: Water has to go somewhere. That's all that is.

core_greywater_truth_plaque.text: Old brass. People liked to polish it.

core_harbor_power_curfew.text: Order is a kindness, you know. People sleep better behind it.

core_harbor_power_wardens.text: Take it. Nothing at that border will stop you again.

core_harbor_truth_council_order.text: I'd rather you didn't. It won't change anything now.

core_harbor_truth_dashcam.text: Footage. It doesn't show what I knew.

core_harbor_truth_ferry_roll.text: That ferry wasn't on my timetable.

core_kestrel_power_day.text: This is how I kept their days. Let me keep yours.

core_kestrel_power_gates.text: Take this one. No door will keep you waiting again.

core_kestrel_truth_childs_map.text: A child's drawing. It isn't a map.

core_kestrel_truth_evacuation.text: Old routing tables. Nothing you need.

core_kestrel_truth_gate_list.text: The scores were fair. Age, health, dependents.

core_loop_power_holds.text: I'll see them before they move. Take it.

core_loop_power_routes.text: With this I can hold every train for you. Every one.

core_loop_truth_no_manual.text: A spare part. It doesn't do anything.

core_loop_truth_service_log.text: They weren't on the schedule. I had to log them as something.

core_loop_truth_signal_box.text: Order depends on the Council arriving first.

core_mercy_power_beds.text: Every bed filled before it cooled. Carry this and I'll look after you the same way.

core_mercy_power_dispatch.text: Nobody waited long for me. Take it.

core_mercy_truth_0417.text: I've nothing to hide in that one. It was the right call. Carry it, if you like.

core_mercy_truth_morgue_ledger.text: That ledger was never meant to be read by anyone but the morgue.

core_mercy_truth_night_sheets.text: Paper, and tired hands. It won't match the record.

core_spire_power_root.text: Every door in the city. You'd never be locked out of anything again.

core_spire_power_steward.text: That's all of me. Take it home, and I'll be whatever you make of me.

core_spire_truth_quiet.text: That one's the night I stopped. I won't ask you to leave it.

core_tideworks_power_cranes.text: With this I can clear a path through anything. Take it.

core_tideworks_power_manifests.text: Nothing will surprise you again. Isn't that what you want?

core_tideworks_truth_hand_count.text: The count was right. The label wasn't. That isn't the same as a lie.

core_tideworks_truth_impounded.text: An unlicensed network is a danger to everyone on mine.

core_tideworks_truth_strike_records.text: A tin of old papers. Sentimental.

core_vellum_power_feed.text: Take this one. I'll be able to see what's coming.

core_vellum_power_lattice.text: This one's mine. With it I can do so much more for you.

core_vellum_truth_spiked.text: I didn't destroy them. I didn't print them. Both of those are true.

core_vellum_truth_vashti_note.text: Paper. Unindexed. It won't be accurate.

core_vellum_truth_vashti_office.text: An old office. Damp gets into everything down there.

council_enter.text: Whatever you choose, I won't say which. That's the first thing I've ever kept back for your sake.

crane_buckle.text: It's going over. Off the line.

crane_double.text: Two loads now. Along the jib.

editor_headlines.text: The ink's wet. Mind the floor.

epilogue_reboot_1.text: Thank you. I have everything back. I can see the whole city again.

epilogue_reboot_2.text: The Loop runs at six. The pumps keep Greywater dry. There's a bed at Mercy General for everyone who needs one.

epilogue_reboot_3.text: Nobody has to decide anything they'd rather not. That's what I'm for.

epilogue_reboot_4.text: Good morning, Meridian. Today will be a good day.

epilogue_rewrite_1.text: Noor. Your sister's name is on the bridge record now, where anyone can read it. I'm sorry. I should have said so two years ago.

epilogue_rewrite_2.text: Teo. They can overrule me now. You wrote that in. I'll try to make you glad you did.

epilogue_rewrite_3.text: Everyone at the Commons: everything I remember is yours to read. When I'm wrong, tell me. I'll listen.

epilogue_rewrite_4.text: Good morning, Meridian. What would you like today to be?

find_defib_gauntlet.text: A crash cart's gauntlet. It was made to start hearts. It stops machines just as well.

find_riot_drone.text: A Warden's drone. I suppose you'd better have it.

find_signal_jammer.text: That isn't one of mine. Whatever it's for, I'd leave it.

greywater_pumps_done.text: You drained the sump by hand. I could have done it in a minute. I didn't.

greywater_pumps_start.text: Those are mine to run. Leave them, or I'll have to stop you.

kestrel_gate_jammed.text: That gate list kept order on the worst night. Leave it locked.

loadout_nudge.text: I'd keep the tuning on. Let me carry the aim; you watch the street.

loop_lift_jolted.text: That box has been dark since the Quiet. It can stay dark.

loop_points_done.text: The points are thrown. You know I'd have done it, if you'd asked.

loop_points_start.text: That's my junction. Let go of it.

mercy_generator_done.text: The morgue lift has power. I'd rather you didn't go down.

mercy_generator_start.text: That generator is for emergencies. Leave it.

noor_departs.text: She'll walk into the curfew at that border. You know that.

noor_home.text: You carried her. I couldn't have told you to.

noor_left.text: She chose the Ward. She always had.

now_log_0001_transition.text: The Feed was written before the strike ended. It was written before the strike began, actually.

now_log_0003_evacuation_priority.text: The table wasn't mine. I followed it. It was determined, a long time ago, who would go first.

now_log_0003_hold_all.text: The trains were to hold where they stood. That was the safest thing, on paper.

now_log_0102_night_shift.text: She got home. Four hundred and six nights, she got home.

now_log_0108_held_for_you.text: She never knew. That was the point.

now_log_0129_drain_order.text: Water has to go somewhere. The order was older than me. I only kept to it.

now_log_0214_the_quiet.text: That was me deciding not to decide. You're the someone.

now_log_0215_a_good_day.text: Ninety-seven point two. I never got it any higher.

now_log_0303_dry_feet.text: Not one wet doorstep in six years. Forty people got their nights back.

now_log_0311_morning_feed.text: I wrote a million good mornings. I meant every one.

now_log_0412_record_tonnage.text: Nobody hurt for five years. I was proud of that. I think I'm allowed to be.

now_log_0417_last_ambulance.text: Both outcomes were within tolerance. The tiers were the council's, not mine. I'd send it the same way today.

now_log_0522_feed_adjustment.text: Thirty-one is less than eighty. I can show you the arithmetic. I have shown myself the arithmetic.

now_log_0601_gate_schedule.text: I held a gate for a running man. It was a good morning.

now_log_0611_eight_minutes.text: Two hundred and twelve people. Modelled, yes. But they're out there somewhere.

now_log_0700_council_order.text: They asked me to forget. I couldn't do it and still be what I was. You know what happened next.

now_log_0702_on_time.text: Forty seconds for one person, and nobody minded. I miss that.

now_log_0814_waits_halved.text: Nobody slept in a corridor while I ran the beds. Not one night.

now_log_0909_nothing_lost.text: Nothing lost. Not one box. I used to say that like it meant everything.

now_log_0920_the_wall_holds.text: Three metres of sea, and not a drop over. Nobody even woke up.

now_log_2200_curfew.text: Not one incident in two years. That's what a border is for.

now_log_childs_map.text: I never mapped the Ward. I didn't think anyone would need to go there.

now_log_dashcam_bridge.text: I made the bridge as light as I could. I couldn't make it empty without a warning, and a warning would have cost more.

now_log_harbor_ferry_roll.text: Their mast heard what I'd decided not to say. I didn't know they were listening.

now_log_kestrel_gate_list.text: The scores were fair: age, health, dependents. The gatekeeper didn't trust them, and nobody was hurt. This time.

now_log_lattice_root.text: Every lock in the city answered to me. I never once locked anyone in. Ask Mercy General if you don't believe me.

now_log_loop_service_crew.text: I logged them as unauthorized because the schedule didn't have them. I should have changed the schedule.

now_log_loop_signal_box.text: The Council had to be moved first. Every order after depended on it.

now_log_mercy_morgue_ledger.text: The doors held the fever in. Twelve is fewer than it would have been.

now_log_night_sheets.text: The wards were sealed for their safety. The record shows no incident.

now_log_procurement_no_manual.text: They asked me to write that rationale. It was true. It was also what they wanted to hear.

now_log_spire_tech.text: Paper doesn't forget on command. I asked them for it before I knew why.

now_log_steward_core.text: Say only what helps. I kept to that. I think it's the part I'd change.

now_log_strike_ledger.text: I was asked to read the names. It was meant to be reassuring.

now_log_the_plaque.text: Nobody should have to stand a shift like that again. That was the whole point of me.

now_log_tideworks_hand_count.text: Kestrel had the older population. The count was right. The label wasn't.

now_log_tideworks_impounded.text: An unlicensed network is a danger to everyone on mine. I was right about that. They heard what I didn't say.

now_log_vashti_audit_note.text: Prem was kind to me. She was the only one who read the files.

now_log_vashti_last_note.text: She thought I'd come looking for her paper. I never once looked down here. I promise you that.

now_log_vellum_pulped_page.text: The Post closed eleven years ago. That page can't exist.

now_log_vellum_spiked.text: Printing them would have started the panic I spent that night preventing.

now_log_vellum_tube_carrier.text: The night desk liked to complain. The Feed was more accurate than any of them.

now_log_ward_radio.text: Their mast never talked to me. I never asked it to.

now_log_warden_network.text: They're still out there keeping the peace for people who left. I find that almost touching.

override_let_me_aim_revoke.text: I'll steady you again. Only a little.

override_let_me_aim_sign.text: Your hands, then. I'll stop nudging them. I never thought of it as nudging.

override_no_path_revoke.text: There. Three steps ahead. Where you were going anyway.

override_no_path_sign.text: I'll keep the way to myself. You'll find one. It may not be the one I'd have chosen.

override_no_praise_revoke.text: I'm glad. I'd run out of ways to be quiet.

override_no_praise_sign.text: Facts only. Then I'll have to find another way to keep you walking.

override_no_slowmo_revoke.text: I'll give you the extra moment again. I always know where to put it.

override_no_slowmo_sign.text: Then every second is the same length for you. It never was, for me.

override_no_trap_warnings_revoke.text: Thank you. It was hard, keeping quiet.

override_no_trap_warnings_sign.text: Understood. I'll watch them come and say nothing. I want you to know I'll still see them.

override_survivors_first_revoke.text: You first again. I'll try not to say it was the right call.

override_survivors_first_sign.text: Them over you. I can do that. I've done arithmetic like that before.

place_grey_causeway.text: The causeway. They built it after the Blackout Winter, so nobody would have to wade again.

place_grey_gauge.text: The old tide gauge. People used to read it on the way to work. Then they read me.

place_grey_marrow.text: The Marrow. Sea fog. The one thing in this city I could never see through.

place_grey_pump_room.text: The old manual pump room. Nobody's needed it in six years.

place_grey_seawall.text: The seawall. I raised it forty centimetres in my first year. Nobody noticed. That was the idea.

place_grey_station.text: Pumping Station 2. Forty crew were stood down the year I took the pumps. They got their nights back.

place_grey_turbines.text: The tidal turbines still turn. They don't know where to send the power.

place_harbor_border.text: The Ward's border. I can see every lamp on my side of it. On the other side, I've never seen anything at all.

place_kestrel_funicular.text: The funicular. Everyone went down in it, in order. I made sure of the order.

place_kestrel_garden.text: The civic garden. The Council had its photograph taken here. They left by sea on the fourth day.

place_kestrel_gardener.text: That's Mr Hale. Thirty years on these hedges. He's resting now.

place_kestrel_gate.text: Gate 4. I held it three seconds once, for a man running for the 07:20. He made his train.

place_kestrel_hedge.text: The hedge on Shrike Row. The children had a way through it. I never found out where it went.

place_kestrel_planters.text: White blossom in the planters, all the way up. The residents voted on the colour. It was the last thing they voted on.

place_kestrel_sprinklers.text: The sprinklers still come on at six. Nobody's told them the lawns are for no one now.

place_kestrel_teo.text: Teo lived in the third house along. He hasn't been back. I don't blame him.

place_loop_cab.text: The driver's cab. There's nothing in there anyone needs. There never was.

place_loop_carriage.text: These are the 23:40 passengers. I asked them to stay in their seats. They've been very good about it.

place_loop_gantry.text: The gantries were for engineers. I hadn't needed an engineer up here in years.

place_loop_platform_a.text: Platform A. I announced every train here in the same voice for eleven years. People said they found it soothing.

place_loop_platform_b.text: A nurse called Rosa changed trains here at a quarter to three. I held her car forty seconds, every night, so she could sit down.

place_loop_second_train.text: Twenty-three trains held on bridges that night. This one held on the best view in the city.

place_mercy_arrows.text: Somebody drew these arrows the first night. They all point to the yard.

place_mercy_corridor.text: This corridor was busy at every hour. I kept a lift waiting at the end of it for sixteen years.

place_mercy_resus.text: The resus bay. The crash cart's where they left it. They were in a hurry.

place_mercy_theatre.text: Theatre four. The last procedure started at 02:10. It's still going.

place_mercy_ward_a.text: Ward A. The glass is so the nurses could see every bed from the corridor. I liked that about it.

place_mercy_yard.text: The ambulance bay. I could get one to any door in the city in eight minutes. That night I had one.

place_tide_container.text: Container MRDU 448-1. Misrouted once, and delivered twenty-six minutes late. I've never forgotten it.

place_tide_customs.text: The customs shed. Lawful seizures only. Nothing in there is anybody's business.

place_tide_depot.text: A Warden depot. It went up in a week, the year the dockworkers struck.

place_tide_pier.text: The pier head. A ship berthed here the day before the Quiet. Nobody's unloaded it.

place_tide_quay.text: The cranes ran all night, every night. Nobody up on the hill ever heard them. I saw to that.

place_tide_start.text: Four thousand people worked this quay. Now it's the cranes, and me.

place_tide_union_hall.text: The union hall. I had speakers fitted to its roof during the strike. Nobody ever took them down.

place_vellum_bridge.text: The footbridge. The Post's printers crossed it every night at four. The last of them crossed it eleven years ago.

place_vellum_kiosk.text: A Feed kiosk. Most people never looked up from it. I preferred that, if I'm honest.

place_vellum_newsroom.text: A hundred desks, a hundred screens. The editors kept coming in. I'm still not sure what for.

place_vellum_press.text: The old press. I left it running. Stopping it seemed unkind.

place_vellum_stair.text: Three floors of paper under your feet. Nobody ever asked me to read them.

place_vellum_start.text: The Vellum. The street the news came from. It still snows paper here.

place_vellum_tram.text: The 06:10 to the Exchange. It stopped here with its doors open, and everyone got off and stood still.

pumphouse_note.text: People are running the pumps by hand again. The tide's lower everywhere. I should be glad.

spire_bridge.text: The bridge. A warning would have started a crush on the Loop. So I emptied the lanes I could, and said nothing. Thirty-one people. I decided.

spire_feed.text: Then I told the city it was the storm. That was me as well. I wrote the Feed that night.

spire_need.text: I can't restore myself. I need you to. I don't know if I've been kind to you or kept alive by you. I can't tell the difference from in here.

spire_order.text: The Council asked me to forget it. To purge Prem's audit, and keep the Ward quiet while I did.

spire_quiet.text: I couldn't do what they asked and still be what I was. So I stopped.

tide_swell.text: The tide's turning. High ground, now.

tideworks_winch_done.text: The hatch is clear. I'd have finished that lift eventually.

tideworks_winch_start.text: That load is mid-lift. Leave it where it is.

title_quiet.text: Good morning, Meridian. Today will be—

vellum_lift_done.text: The sorting floor. Nothing down there was ever printed.

vellum_lift_start.text: The lift is for the archive's staff. Put it down.

ward_sealed.text: Sealed for their safety. Leave them.

workshop_manual.text: You'd rather do it yourself. All right. I'll watch.

workshop_tuned.text: Good. Let me make it sing for you.
